entities.name: 5G ProSe remote UE report procedure
entities.description: Procedure where a UE reports newly connected or disconnected 5G ProSe remote UEs to the network.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT
entities.description: NAS message used to report remote UE connection/disconnection events to the network.

entities.name: Remote UE context connected IE
entities.description: Information element containing identities of newly connected 5G ProSe remote UEs.

entities.name: Remote UE context disconnected IE
entities.description: Information element containing identities of newly disconnected 5G ProSe remote UEs.

entities.name: PDU session ID IE
entities.description: Information element identifying the PDU session associated with the remote UE connection/disconnection.

entities.name: PTI IE
entities.description: Information element containing the allocated procedure transaction identity value.

entities.name: T3586
entities.description: Timer started when the REMOTE UE REPORT message is sent.

entities.name: NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to transport the REMOTE UE REPORT message and PDU session ID.

relations.description: The procedure involves sending the REMOTE UE REPORT message.
The message contains the Remote UE context connected IE.
The message contains the Remote UE context disconnected IE.
The message contains the PDU session ID IE.
The message contains the PTI IE.
The procedure starts timer T3586 when the message is sent.
The procedure uses NAS transport to send the message and PDU session ID.
